criteria.description: No sorry in proof or source files

verify.run: ! grep -rn 'sorry' --include='*.lean' Qed/ Tests/ Main.lean 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^\s*--' | grep -q .

criteria.description: Generated docs are fresh (schema and format reference match source)

verify.run: lake build docgen && .lake/build/bin/docgen schema | diff docs/spec.schema.json - && .lake/build/bin/docgen markdown | diff docs/spec-format.md -
